variants.label: Flagged as malicious
variants.body: The file hash {{hash}} was submitted to VirusTotal; {{detections}} of {{total}} vendors flagged it as malicious.

variants.label: No detections
variants.body: The file hash {{hash}} was submitted to VirusTotal; no vendors flagged it as malicious.

variants.label: Not known to VirusTotal
variants.body: The file hash {{hash}} was submitted to VirusTotal; the file is not present in the dataset, so no reputation data is available.

variants.label: No findings
variants.body: Entra ID sign-in logs for {{user}} were reviewed - no indicators of malicious behaviour found.

variants.label: Suspicious sign-ins found
variants.body: Entra ID sign-in logs for {{user}} show successful sign-ins from {{country}} at {{signin_time}}, inconsistent with the user's established pattern.

variants.label: Logs unavailable
variants.body: Entra ID sign-in logs for {{user}} could not be reviewed - no log data is available for the relevant period.

variants.label: Disabled and sessions revoked
variants.body: The account {{user}} has been disabled and all active sessions revoked. A password reset is required before the account is re-enabled.

variants.label: Password reset only
variants.body: A password reset has been enforced on {{user}}. The account remains enabled and is being monitored.

variants.label: Awaiting business approval
variants.body: Containment of {{user}} is on hold pending business approval; the account remains active and under monitoring.

placeholders.label: URL
placeholders.hint: Paste the full URL including scheme; it will be defanged automatically

variants.label: Connection blocked
variants.body: A connection attempt to {{url}} was observed and blocked by the web proxy. No successful communication took place.

variants.label: Connection succeeded
variants.body: A successful connection to {{url}} was observed. The endpoint has been isolated pending further analysis.

variants.label: Known malicious
variants.body: The IP address {{ip}} is documented in threat intelligence sources as associated with malicious activity. It has been added to the block list.

variants.label: No adverse intelligence
variants.body: The IP address {{ip}} was checked against available threat intelligence sources; no adverse reputation was found.

variants.label: Confirmed phishing
variants.body: The email from {{sender}} with the subject "{{subject}}" has been assessed as phishing. It has been removed from all affected mailboxes and the sender has been blocked.

variants.label: Spam, not phishing
variants.body: The email from {{sender}} with the subject "{{subject}}" has been assessed as unsolicited bulk mail rather than a targeted phishing attempt. No further action is required.

variants.label: Legitimate email
variants.body: The email from {{sender}} with the subject "{{subject}}" has been assessed as legitimate. The reporting user has been informed; no action is required.

variants.label: No interaction
variants.body: {{user}} confirmed they did not open any attachment, follow any link, or enter credentials. No further containment is required.

variants.label: Link followed, no credentials
variants.body: {{user}} confirmed they followed the link but did not enter credentials. Proxy logs were reviewed to corroborate this.

variants.label: Credentials entered
variants.body: {{user}} confirmed they entered credentials. The account password has been reset, active sessions revoked, and sign-in activity reviewed for unauthorised access.

variants.label: True positive
variants.body: The detection on {{host}} has been confirmed as a true positive. The endpoint has been isolated and is pending remediation.

variants.label: False positive
variants.body: The detection on {{host}} has been assessed as a false positive: {{reason}}. A tuning exception has been requested.

placeholders.label: Reason
placeholders.hint: What legitimate activity triggered the detection?

variants.label: Benign true positive
variants.body: The activity detected on {{host}} did occur as reported, but was authorised administrative activity rather than an attack. No further action is required.

variants.label: Isolated
variants.body: {{host}} has been network-isolated via the EDR console. Management connectivity is retained for investigation.

variants.label: Isolation released
variants.body: Isolation of {{host}} has been released following remediation and a clean scan. The endpoint has been returned to the user.

templates.title: Log review scope statement

placeholders.label: Log source
placeholders.hint: e.g. proxy, firewall, Entra ID sign-in

templates.body: {{source}} logs were reviewed for the period {{from}} to {{to}}.

variants.label: Closed - no impact
variants.body: Investigation complete. No evidence of compromise or business impact was identified. Closing as a true positive with no impact.

variants.label: Closed - remediated
variants.body: Investigation complete. The identified activity has been contained and remediated, and no further malicious activity has been observed. Closing as resolved.

variants.label: Closed - false positive
variants.body: Investigation complete. The alert has been assessed as a false positive; a detection tuning request has been raised. Closing as a false positive.

variants.label: Escalated
variants.body: This incident has been escalated to {{team}} for further investigation. Handover notes and all collected evidence have been attached to this ticket.
